whatsapp_manual.title: Manual WhatsApp
whatsapp_manual.subtitle: Messages awaiting manual delivery
whatsapp_manual.instructions: Open the draft in WhatsApp and send it there. Then mark it as sent. DentalPin records who declared the send.
whatsapp_manual.emptyDetail: WhatsApp drafts will appear here when they are ready.
whatsapp_manual.openError: This draft can no longer be opened. Check consent, the phone number and the appointment date.
whatsapp_manual.appointmentChanged: The appointment was changed or is no longer active. Prepare a new message from the current appointment.
whatsapp_manual.actionError: The tray changed or the action could not be saved. Try again.
whatsapp_manual.composeHelp: Write a message to prepare in the manual WhatsApp tray.
whatsapp_manual.queued: Message queued. It will appear in the tray when ready.
whatsapp_manual.queueError: Could not prepare the message. Check consent, the phone number and the manual WhatsApp settings.
whatsapp_manual.disabled: Manual WhatsApp is currently unselected for this clinic.
whatsapp_manual.enableHelp: Selecting it replaces the clinic’s current WhatsApp adapter.
whatsapp_manual.configError: Could not change the WhatsApp adapter
